_hostTokens: The contract. Every token here is the CONSUMING app's to define -- font-proofer and ReCal both do, which is why bare reads work today. Written down so a new consumer can be checked against a list instead of discovering the set by rendering black on black. Adding a name here is a promise that every consumer defines it.
_runtimeTokens: Set by this package's own JS onto its own elements, so they are never in a stylesheet. Not a contract with anybody -- a rename here is ours to make on both sides at once.
